map.相对论速度叠加计算器 使用指南: Relativistic Velocity Addition Calculator User Guide
map.相对论速度叠加计算器在高速参考系下合成速度，采用 (u+v)/(1+uv/c²): The Relativistic Velocity Addition Calculator composes velocities in a high-speed reference frame using (u+v)/(1+uv/c²); the result never exceeds the speed of light, which makes it good for understanding special relativity and near-light-speed scenarios.
map.高速参考系下的速度合成，永不超光速。: Velocity composition in a high-speed reference frame, never exceeding the speed of light.
map.填写「物体相对速度 u′ (c)」。: Enter the object relative velocity u′ (c).
map.填写「参考系速度 v (c)」。: Enter the reference frame velocity v (c).
map.填写「光速 c (m/s)」。: Enter the speed of light c (m/s).
map.接近光速时速度不能简单相加。: Near the speed of light, velocities cannot simply be added.
map.高速情形下合成两个速度，保证结果不超过光速。: Compose two velocities at high speed, guaranteeing that the result does not exceed the speed of light.
map.：u = (0.6c+0.6c)/(1+0.6×0.6) = 1.2c/1.36: u = (0.6c+0.6c)/(1+0.6×0.6) = 1.2c/1.36 ≈ 0.882c. That is, two 0.6c velocities add to less than c and never exceed the speed of light.
map.两个速度各为 0.5c，光速取 3×10⁸ m/s: The two speeds are 0.5c each, with the speed of light taken as 3×10⁸ m/s
map.：u=(u′+v)/(1+u′v/c²)=(0.5+0.5)/(1+0.25)=: u=(u′+v)/(1+u′v/c²)=(0.5+0.5)/(1+0.25)=0.800000 c, that is about 2.400×10⁸ m/s. Classical mechanics adding directly gives 1.0c, which clearly violates relativity.
map.由每分钟转数求角速度: Angular velocity from revolutions per minute
map.由初速度与减速度求制动时间: Braking time from initial speed and deceleration
map.由角加速度与半径求切向加速度: Tangential acceleration from the angular acceleration and the radius
map.为什么不超过 c？: Why does it never exceed c?
map.经典相加得 1.2c 错；相对论分母 1+u′v/c² 修正后结果恒 < c，光: Classic addition giving 1.2c is wrong; with the relativistic denominator 1+u′v/c² the result is always below c, and the speed of light cannot be exceeded.
map.日常速度为什么感觉不到这个差别？: Why can't I feel the difference at everyday speeds?
map.因为修正项 u′v/c² 极小。以两列 350 km/h 的高铁相向为例，uv/: Because the correction term u′v/c² is extremely small. Take two high-speed trains at 350 km/h running towards each other: uv/c² is only on the order of 10⁻¹², and the difference between the relativistic result and simple addition is far below the measurement error of any instrument. The correction only becomes significant when the speeds approach that of light.
